description: Generic components for palletizing/picking workcells: pallet, pick-station, safety hardware (fence, light curtain, e-stop, stack-light), decoration (tote-stack, robot-pedestal, hmi-cabinet, floor-decal, workcell-bounds), and a workcell-scene WSS service that publishes all of them to the 3D viewer.

models.description: Pallet (slatted GMA or plastic). Frame origin = bounding-box centroid; set frame.translation.z = thickness_mm/2 (~76 mm default) to rest on floor.

Inbound conveyor / pick fixture (rollers, rails, legs, direction arrow). Frame origin = bounding-box centroid; set frame.translation.z = lowest_point_height_mm + thickness_mm/2 to match a real conveyor height.
World-state-store service that polls every configured workcell component's get_visuals and publishes them to the 3D viewer. No frame block (it's a service).
Wire-mesh perimeter panel (rails, posts, translucent screen). Frame origin = centerline of the panel base on the floor (z=0 puts it on the floor); local +X runs along the panel.
Paired-tower light curtain. Frame origin = floor midway between the two towers (z=0 on the floor); local +X = span (tower-to-tower).
Mushroom-button on a yellow post. Frame origin = center of the base plate on the floor (z=0 on the floor).
Multi-segment status beacon (per-segment color + state). Frame origin = center of the base on the floor (z=0 on the floor).
Stack of N identical totes/boxes. Frame origin = bottom face of the bottom-most box; the stack grows from here along stack_axis.
Base under the robot arm (foot, column, flange). Frame origin = center of the base on the floor (z=0 on the floor).
Operator HMI panel on a support post. Frame origin = center of the support post's base on the floor (z=0 on the floor).
Solid or hazard-striped floor decal. Frame origin = bottom face of the decal flush with the floor (z=0 on the floor); the decal extends upward by thickness_mm.
Wire-frame footprint of the cell. Frame origin = centroid of the bounding volume; set frame.translation.z = height_mm/2 to put the floor of the box at z=0.
Presence sensor over the pick-station infeed. Readings: box_present, seconds_until_next. DoCommand {"take": true} consumes the waiting box and starts the next interval.
Pallet occupancy, derived by counting box transforms in a world state store (default pack-sequencer). Readings: pallet_empty, pallet_full, boxes_on_pallet, capacity.
